notes: The gold cloud turns continuously now instead of jumping back to the start every second. The panel redraws its contents once a second as new readings arrive, and the cloud was being rebuilt along with everything else - so it never got more…
The same cause made it disappear when paused: a freshly built cloud that starts stopped never draws its first frame, leaving an empty black square. A paused cloud now holds its picture.

Related fix in the same animation used by the loading screen: it repaints itself once after being resized while stopped. Changing a canvas size erases it, and with the animation halted there was nothing left to draw it back.
